title.en: Ti and TiN are not the same kind of barrier

subtitle.zh: 位置相邻，但每一层解决的问题不同
subtitle.en: They are adjacent, but each layer solves a different problem

body.zh: 介质层；Ti（附着层）；TiN（阻挡 / 成核界面）；W成核层；Bulk W（主体填充）；接触底部/ 基底
body.en: Dielectric Ti (adhesion layer) TiN (barrier / nucleation interface) W nucleation layer Bulk W (main fill) Contact bottom / substrate

body.zh: Ti | 抓住界面；提升附着，吸杂，；并参与接触控制
body.en: Ti | secure the interface Improve adhesion and getter impurities, and contribute to contact control

body.zh: 2；TiN |隔开反应；抑制WF₆相关反应，；形成连续阻挡；WF₆等；反应物
body.en: 2 TiN | isolate reactions Suppress WF₆-related reactions, forming a continuous barrier WF₆ and other reactants

body.zh: 3；W成核|铺好起点；让后续W从连续；表面开始生长
body.en: 3 W nucleation | establish a starting surface Allow subsequent W growth to begin on a continuous surface

body.zh: 4；Bulk W | 完成填充；占据孔内主体；导电体积
body.en: 4 Bulk W | complete the fill Occupy the main conductive volume inside the opening

body.zh: 错误理解；Ti与 TiN只是两层相同的Barrier；Ti；TiN；把两层当作作用相同、可互换
body.en: Misconception Ti and TiN are merely two identical barrier layers Ti TiN Treating both layers as equivalent and interchangeable

body.zh: 正确理解；Ti管附着与接触；TiN管隔离与成核界面
body.en: Correct interpretation Ti manages adhesion and contact; TiN manages isolation and the nucleation interface

body.zh: 介质层；Ti（附着层）；提升附着，参与接触控制
body.en: Dielectric Ti (adhesion layer) Improve adhesion and contribute to contact control

body.zh: TiN（阻挡 / 成核界面）；抑制反应，形成连续阻挡
body.en: TiN (barrier / nucleation interface) Suppress reactions and form a continuous barrier

body.zh: W成核层；提供连续表面，启动生长
body.en: W nucleation layer Provide a continuous surface to initiate growth

body.zh: Bulk W（主体填充）；提供导电体积，完成填充
body.en: Bulk W (main fill) Provide the conductive volume to complete the fill

body.zh: 看层栈不能只背材料名，要看它夹在哪两个界面之间
body.en: Read the stack by the two interfaces each layer lies between, not just material names

notes.zh: 原图把Ti/TiN角色画成概念层栈；此处只忠实记录，不推定真实工艺厚度。
notes.en: The source presents a conceptual Ti/TiN stack; no actual process thickness is inferred.
